actions: Reset poller-backoff consecutiveNoOp 73->0, nextRunAfter->0 (committed+pushed)
Audited 14 existing review-texts files vs 5 scored — found 2 real, on-target reviews that were wrongly excluded

BUG #1 (fixed): this-week-in-new-york (twi-ny.com) review was flagged wrongProduction because its own LLM-scoring date-fallback misparsed the site's visible date format '25 Jul/26' (meaning July 25, 2026) as 2025-07-25 — a full year off, triggering the 342-day pre-opening guard. Verified via direct HTML fetch: twi-ny.com has zero date meta/JSON-LD, so date extraction fell through to an LLM-scoring fallback step that misread the ambiguous format. Corrected via ingest-manual-review.js (--publish-date=2026-07-25, --score=59, --force-clear-stale-flag), which also fixed a resulting wrong-direction duplicateOf stamp via heal-duplicate-of-direction.js --fix.

BUG #2 (fixed): lavocedinewyork.com (La Voce di New York) had a real, on-target 2026-08-08 review of this exact show, but article-extractor.js had no pattern for this outlet's Jannah/JNews WordPress theme (no stable DOM class), so extraction returned ~117 chars and it silently saved as a stub, never reaching the corpus. Added a new extractLaVoceBody() pattern that reads the JSON-LD Article.articleBody field directly (verified against 2 live URLs: this Hungry Women review + an unrelated Blackout Songs review, both extracted cleanly). Committed to scripts/lib/article-extractor.js (worktree death-note-recovery-1342, merged to main, commit a459256e1dc), then used ingest-review-from-url.js to add the review.

Both fixes pushed to data/review-texts (private repo, commit a51afe4d064) after carefully separating from ~90 files of unrelated pre-existing drift already dirty in that repo at session start (stashed, not touched, not lost)
Triggered 2 rebuild-reviews.yml runs (first ran on stale checkout before both fixes landed; second — run 31646933406 — dispatched after both pushes)

CAUGHT AND DISCARDED a stray local full-corpus rebuild: gather-reviews.js's internal pipeline ran rebuild-all-reviews.js locally against the shared ~/broadway-scorecard-data clone (writing local diffs for dozens of unrelated shows) — discarded via git checkout before any commit/push, per the 'never rebuild-all-reviews.js locally' rule

Remaining 7 excluded files (broadwaypodcastnetwork, iloveny: not_a_review; melissamaney, sohoplayhouse, broadwayworld: truncated <1000 chars, all listing/ticket pages; new-york-sun: stub, likely paywalled; show-score: wrongShow+not_a_review; theatrely: wrongProduction, correctly — it's a 2-show roundup article bundling Hungry Women with The Pass) — all correctly excluded
shows.remainingGaps: Real fix delivered — 2 legitimate reviews recovered (This Week in New York T3, La Voce di New York T3), bringing the show to 7 total. Still 0 true T1/T2 (New York Theatre Guide/Off Off Online/Pages on Stages/Talkin' Broadway/Theater Scene/This Week in New York/La Voce di New York are all T3-tier). No further recoverable reviews found in review-texts or _pending. The new-york-sun stub is worth a follow-up if NY Sun coverage matters (likely paywalled — check with a dedicated extractor pattern in a future session).
